Categories.value: Tamara Taylor|Taken with Nikon D700|Fashion in 2012|Flickr images uploaded by Flickr upload bot|Files with derivative versions|Women wearing red dresses|Women standing on catwalks|Files from Jason Hargrove Flickr stream|The Heart Dress|The Heart Truth's Red Dress Collection 2012 Fashion Show in Toronto

ImageDescription.value:
Tamara Taylor found quick success in her career through nationally televised commercials. Just months after moving to Los Angeles from her hometown of Toronto, Tamara had booked parts in both TV and film.

Her first big break came when she landed a series regular role on the hit series Party of Five, playing Matthew Fox’s love interest “Grace”. Later, she starred as “Dr. Ana Syphax” in Steven Bocho’s drama City of Angels with Blair Underwood. She has also had roles in Hidden Hills opposite Paula Marshall and Sex, Love & Secrets with Denise Richards and Eric Balfour. No stranger to television drama series, Tamara has also made guest appearances on NCIS, Numb3rs, Lost, CSI: Miami, Without a Trace and Dawson’s Creek.

Tamara made her feature film debut as Marlon Wayans’ love interest in the romantic comedy Senseless. She was also in the critically acclaimed cable biopic Introducing Dorothy Dandridge, the box office hit Diary of a Mad Black Woman and Joss Whedon’s sci-fi adventure Serenity.

Her most current and famed role is that of “Dr. Camille Saroyan”, Head of the Forensic Division, on the popular crime drama series Bones.

From one of North Americas only free-standing independent Atelier’s, Mark Belford takes the design conception to a Couture execution. By private commission Belford delivers to a niche private clientele consisting of discerning creative patrons. Celebrities, Socialites, Political Dignitaries and Royalty.

These commissions have taken the boy ‘who designed his first dress at 4yrs of age’ to the drawing rooms of Beverly Hills, Park Avenue through to the Ocean Estates of Palm Beach. The soundstages of CBS, The red carpets of The Emmy’s, The Academy Awards and currently in presentation considerations for the Princely and Royal families of Monaco and England respectively.

<a href="http://markbelford.com" rel="nofollow">markbelford.com</a>

+

In 2012, The Heart Truth® marks a decade of commitment to women's heart health. Starting with February's American Heart Month and throughout the year, the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) reaffirms its commitment to increasing awareness about heart disease among women and helping women take steps to reduce their own personal risk of developing heart disease.
